title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I had a child of 1 week. can i go to hajj with my wife, keeping in view that she is feeding baby 1796 views Q. Assalamualaykum Q-A person said that it is bidah to write or call a person who has done hajj a haji because the Sahabah did not call each other by haji is he right?and is it permissible to write haji before some ones name? 4419 views Q. State of Ihraam/taharah 4435 views Q. Insha Allah this year myself and my wife are going for Haj Pilgrimage. As Haqeeqah was not done for my wife by her parents so far, kindly let me know whether it is compulsory for her to do haqeeqah, (slaughtering one sheep) before proceeding for Haj pilgrimage. Also it will be helpful for us if you provide more information regarding Haj. 2628 views Q. I want to know that if i am going to makkah for umrah from india, can i make niyyat and offer two rakat from bombay in pant and shirt and wen i reach jeddah i will change my clothes and wear ihram on jeddah airport. is it right to do that? 4485 views Q. Tawaf 2766 views Q. Can we perform Umrah or tawaf for deceased? 7765 views Q. I am a well-to-do person; I would like to know can I use "Hajj Subsidy" by applying through Hajj Committee? 1906 views Q. Hajj-e-badal -- Farz sawab or Nafl Sawab 3406 views Q. Performing Hajj while doing a job in Saudi Arabia 4239 views Q. I live in Jeddah with my wife. We went to perform Umra. We completed the Tawaf and Saee. After that, my wife wanted to cut her hair herself but I told her that only someone who has already got Halaqa can cut your hair. She waited for me so I can get my haircut and then cut her hair. After I had my Haircut, we discovered we did not have a scissors to cut her hair. We thought we can go home (Jeddah) and do that. Once we returned home, we kissed each other. Immediately after, she remembered that she needed to cut her hair. Now, please advise us if we should give any "Dum" having done this? If so, what should it be? and can we give Dum back in Pakistan where people need it the most? 9977 views Q. Performing Umrah with Mehram/husband. 6379 views Q. I plan to do more than one Umrah. I will be shaving off my head completely after the 1st umrah and in the 2nd umrah will not have any hair, still do I have to shave again completely 36726 views Q. I went from USA to Jeddah on April 2010. I stayed with my relatives in Jeddah for 3-4 days, then I made intention of Umrah, put ihram in Jeddah, and went to Makkah to complete my umrah? Was this right? 2056 views Q. Should I perform Umrah first and then Hajj? 6028 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 46323 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Hajj Question: I heard that if someone died while applying and ready to do Hajj, Allah assigns one angel on his place who does Hajj every year on the deceased name. Is that right? What will be the reward for him in front of Allah? Can we call him Shaheed? Answer ID: 46323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1078/1078/M=1434) A person shall get reward for the intention of hajj and its preparation, in-shaAllah. But we could not find the virtues which you have mentioned in the book of Hadith and Fiqh. Rather there is a hadith which says that “a person who goes for hajj and dies in the way, he shall receive the reward of hajj until the Day of Judgment”. عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: من خرج حاجاً فمات كتب له أجر الحاج إلى يوم القيمة ، رواه أبو يعلى من رواية ابن اسحاق وبقية رواته ثقات كذا في الترغيب (فضائل حج ص 25) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
